segments.name: U.S.
segments.description: Operates Outback Steakhouse, Carrabba's Italian Grill, Bonefish Grill and Fleming's Prime Steakhouse & Wine Bar restaurants in the United States, serving guests in restaurant and off premises.
segments.evidence: We aggregate our U.S. operating segments into the U.S. reportable segment.

segments.name: International Franchise
segments.description: Franchises the company's restaurant concepts outside the United States, earning royalties and fees from franchise partners in international markets.
segments.evidence: As of December 28, 2025, our international franchise segment includes 355 franchised restaurants across 11 countries and Guam.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay Company-owned restaurants for food and beverages, while franchisees pay initial franchise fees and monthly royalties, advertising and administration fees.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate our revenues from our Company-owned restaurants and through sales of franchise rights and ongoing royalties and other fees from our franchised restaurants.

changes.text: In 2024 the company sold majority ownership of its Brazil operations while retaining a minority interest, so those restaurants became unconsolidated franchisees.
changes.evidence: On December 30, 2024, we sold 67% of our Brazil operations (the "Brazil Sale Transaction") and retained a 33% interest.
